mike h: Quick help — went to an urgent care while traveling in Mexico (April 10). Provider billed in MXN and carrier denied as out-of-network. I paid cash and have a receipt and EOB. How do I get reimbursed?

emma (people-ops): Sorry that happened. Which plan (Standard/Plus) and did you grab the digital ID card? Don’t post PHI here.

mike h: Plus. I have a photo of the receipt and the provider wrote CPT-like codes on the invoice (not standard US CPT). I uploaded the receipt to the benefits portal. Claim #: TRV-2025-551.

people-ops-bot: Uploads: https://benefits.redwood-inc/claims-upload. For international claims include original receipt, itemized services (with translation if not English), proof of payment, and member ID. Currency conversions: use provider date.

luis (benefits): Hi Mike — for travel urgent care on Plus: emergent/urgent services are usually covered but may be processed as out-of-network. We can submit a manual reimbursement claim. Please attach the receipt, brief note describing what happened, and provider contact if available. For non-standard billing codes we map to closest CPT during adjudication.

mike h: Uploaded docs and a short note. Provider contact = clinica sol, phone +52-55-1234-5678. Receipt total 2,450 MXN (converted to $140 USD).

luis (benefits): Got it. Intake ticket #BP-TRV-2025-901 created. We'll file for reimbursement and request carrier medical review to consider emergent treatment exception. Typical adjudication 10-15 business days after intake. If carrier needs translation we can assist.

mike h: Great — do I need to submit anything else or can you do the rest?

benefits-team: We'll handle carrier submission. If carrier denies, we will appeal and can escalate to our carrier rep. Keep originals in case carrier requests them.

emma (people-ops): Also FYI you can find your digital ID card in the benefits portal under "ID Card" > "Travel" for calls/claims while abroad. If you want we can email you a PDF for your records.

mike h: Please email the PDF. Thanks all for the quick help. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Update: ticket BP-TRV-2025-901 assigned to benefits intake. Carrier outreach started. ETA 10 business days for adjudication.
